crossRefs.note: Yahweh’s law is perfect, restoring the soul. Yahweh’s covenant is sure, making wise the simple.
Yahweh’s precepts are right, rejoicing the heart. Yahweh’s commandment is pure, enlightening the eyes.
I have taken your testimonies as a heritage forever, for they are the joy of my heart.
Your testimonies are wonderful, therefore my soul keeps them.
You have commanded your statutes in righteousness. They are fully trustworthy.
Your testimonies are righteous forever. Give me understanding, that I may live.
Turn to the law and to the covenant! If they don’t speak according to this word, surely there is no morning for them.
Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will not pass away.
In this way God, being determined to show more abundantly to the heirs of the promise the immutability of his counsel…
that by two immutable things, in which it is impossible for God to lie, we may have a strong encouragement, who have…
If we receive the witness of men, the witness of God is greater; for this is God’s testimony which he has testified…
For you are not a God who has pleasure in wickedness. Evil can’t live with you.
Exalt Yahweh our God. Worship at his footstool. He is Holy!
Exalt Yahweh, our God. Worship at his holy hill, for Yahweh, our God, is holy!
Then Moses said to Aaron, “This is what Yahweh spoke of, saying, ‘I will show myself holy to those who come near me…
“Speak to all the congregation of the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘You shall be holy; for I, Yahweh your God, am…
Depart! Depart! Go out from there! Touch no unclean thing! Go out from among her! Cleanse yourselves, you who carry…
In that day there will be on the bells of the horses, “HOLY TO YAHWEH”; and the pots in Yahweh’s house will be like the…
Yes, every pot in Jerusalem and in Judah will be holy to Yahweh of Armies; and all those who sacrifice will come and…
God is spirit, and those who worship him must worship in spirit and truth.”
Don’t you know that you are a temple of God, and that God’s Spirit lives in you?
If anyone destroys God’s temple, God will destroy him; for God’s temple is holy, which you are.
Follow after peace with all men, and the sanctification without which no man will see the Lord,
There will in no way enter into it anything profane, or one who causes an abomination or a lie, but only those who are…

translations.web: Your statutes stand firm. Holiness adorns your house, Yahweh, forever more.
translations.bsb: Your testimonies are fully confirmed; holiness adorns Your house, O LORD, for all the days to come.
translations.kjv: Thy testimonies are very sure: holiness becometh thine house, O LORD, for ever.
translations.asv: Thy testimonies are very sure: Holiness becometh thy house, O Jehovah, for evermore.
